title: Email verification flow
requirements: Send a verification email on registration via Firebase Auth.
Gate protected routes until the email is verified.
Provide a resend-verification action with rate limiting.
Show clear status messaging to the user.
notes: Implemented on top of the existing Firebase Auth workflow. lib/auth.ts gained sendVerificationEmail (with a 60s per-user client-side cooldown and VerificationRateLimitError), getVerificationResendCooldown, reloadUser, subscribeToIdTokenChanges, and verification-specific error mappings. AuthProvider now exposes emailVerified + reloadUser and auto-detects verification via onIdTokenChanged plus a 5s poll and focus/visibility reload while unverified. Registration sends the verification email and redirects unverified users to /verify-email. New /verify-email page shows status messaging, a resend action with a live countdown, and a manual check button. Protected routes are gated by the new RequireVerifiedEmail guard applied via the (app) route-group layout; the home page moved into (app). NavBar surfaces a 'Verify email' link for unverified users. Firebase Auth remains the source of truth for emailVerified (no Firestore write needed). Covered by 50 passing tests (unit + component); typecheck, lint, and static export build all pass.
